subject: general
question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The door was ajar and a faint __wisp__ of smoke floated through it.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"wisp"** means a small thin or twisted bunch, piece, or amount of something. (बारीक रेशा)

 
 
• **Example: **A **wisp **of hair escaped from her bun.
 
 
 
• **"Lot"** refers to a large number or amount of something. (बहुत सारा)
 
 
• **Example: **She has a** lot **of books in her library.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'wisp'** is **'lot'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Itchy** (खुजलीदार): Having or causing an itch.

 
 
• **Example:** The wool sweater made her skin feel itchy.
 
 
 
• **Trickle** (बूँद-बूँद कर टपकना): A small flow of liquid.
 
 
• **Example:** A trickle of water ran down the street.
 
 
 
• **Wind** (हवा): The natural movement of the air.
 
 
• **Example:** The wind was blowing hard during the storm.
